proof_body:
by
  intro R M _ _ _ _ _ hind f
  obtain ⟨n, hc, hn⟩ := (f.eventually_isCompl_ker_pow_range_pow.and (Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0)).exists
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn.ne'
  rcases hind _ _ hc with h | h
  · right
    have hr : LinearMap.range (f ^ (k + 1)) = ⊤ := by
      have := hc.sup_eq_top
      rwa [h, bot_sup_eq] at this
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      have hk := LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.1 h
      apply hk
      rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, hxy]
    · intro y
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := LinearMap.range_eq_top.1 hr y
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply] at hx
      exact ⟨_, hx⟩
  · left
    exact ⟨k + 1, LinearMap.range_eq_bot.1 h⟩
target_source: ∀ (R M : Type*) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [IsArtinian R M] [IsNoetherian R M], (∀ p q : Submodule R M, IsCompl p q → p = ⊥ ∨ q = ⊥) → ∀ f : M →ₗ[R] M, IsNilpotent f ∨ Function.Bijective f
